### Tools

| Tool | What it does | Read-only | Destructive | Posture |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `list_tasklists` | Read one page of the authenticated user's task lists. Returns the intact page envelope, including nextPageToken when present. Pass that value as pageToken to read the next page; absent items means an empty collection. | yes | no | ask |
| `list_tasks` | Read one page of tasks from a task list. Keep filters unchanged when passing nextPageToken as pageToken. Missing items means an empty page. To include completed tasks from Google clients, set both showCompleted and showHidden true. Assigned tasks require showAssigned true. A task's due value contains date information only, not a precise deadline time. | yes | no | ask |
